text:
I found him on the path.
The water did not disturb its dream,
nor did the roses open wider;
amazement opened my soul.
And a poor woman has
a face full of tears!

He carried a light song
in his careless mouth,
and when he looked at me
the song he sang turned grave.
I looked at the path; it seemed
strange, as if dreamed.
And in the diamond dawn
my face was wet with tears.

He went on singing
and carried my gaze away…
Behind him the sages
were no bluer or taller.
No matter! In the air
my soul was left trembling.
Though no one has wounded me,
my face is wet with tears!

Tonight he has not kept vigil
beside the lamp as I have;
since he does not know, my longing
does not prick his narcissus breast;
yet perhaps through his dream
will pass the scent of broom,
for a poor woman
has a face full of tears!

I walked alone and feared nothing;
hungry and thirsty, I did not weep;
since I saw him pass,
my God has clothed me in wounds.
My mother prays for me
on her bed, her prayer trusting.
But perhaps forever
my face will be wet with tears!

translation.title: The Encounter
